what: Post-dedup parity fallback target is undefined in the current pipeline
scenario_or_breakage: Dedup runs on the combined collect stream and writes findings.md; findings-in-scope.md is created only after that split. Wording to fall back to the pre-dedup in-scope stream does not name a file that exists yet, so a parity failure can still feed a ballot missing [SCOPE-REDUCTION] markers
suggested_fix: Name the fallback input explicitly (e.g. FINDING blocks from the pre-dedup collect buffer or pre-dedup findings.md) and skip or bypass dedup before aggregation when parity fails
